Aisha (People Ops): Hi team — quick Q: Maya is returning from parental leave mid-July and is asking to carry over an extra 10 PTO hours beyond the normal carryover cap because our summer partial-shutdown overlaps her return. Is there a standard exception flow?
Maya Rodriguez: Yep, coming back 2026-07-12 and our team has the sprint shutdown 7/19–7/23. I didn’t get to use all my leave because of the leave + a delayed onboarding for the caretaker. Can we make an exception so I can keep those 10 hours?
Manager Liu: Would be great if we can keep her covered. If she can’t use them before the shutdown she’ll be short on coverage and I'll need to shuffle folks. Happy to approve manager sign-off if that helps.
Jamal Chen: FWIW we can shuffle the on-call, but perfect if People Ops can do a one-off carryover.
Sofia Patel: Are we talking about the standard year-end carryover cap (40 hrs) or the midyear cap? Need to confirm which policy applies.
Aisha (People Ops): Good q — the general carryover cap is 40 hrs annually, but we do allow limited exceptions for documented leave + operational blackout overlap. Policy excerpt: `Exceptions: Up to 16 hours may be considered beyond cap with manager approval and documentation of medical/parental leave; must be approved by People Ops and payroll before cutoff.` Link: https://redwood.com/hr/pto-policy
Ethan Lee: So if Maya has parental leave docs + Manager Liu signs off, People Ops can approve up to 16h?
Aisha (People Ops): Correct. For this scenario we'll need: 1) copy of parental leave approval dates, 2) manager sign-off in the thread (can be a quick `+1`), 3) confirmation that the hours can't be reasonably scheduled before the shutdown. If all good, we convert excess into carryover or (if requested) convert to wellness hours one-time.
Maya Rodriguez: I can upload the leave docs to the HR portal today. I’d prefer true carryover vs wellness hours if possible.
Manager Liu: +1 — I confirm these hours can't be scheduled earlier without impacting release.
Sofia Patel: Also check payroll cutoff: our cut for July carryover ops is `2026-07-01` for automated processing; anything after requires manual entry.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks — because payroll cutoff is before Maya's return we'll need a manual override. I'll raise the exception and coordinate with Payroll. Maya — once you upload, reply here with `uploaded` and I’ll file the override ticket.
Maya Rodriguez: uploaded ✅
Aisha (People Ops): Filing exception ticket now: HR-4782. Request: +10h carryover beyond cap for parental leave overlap; manager approved; manual payroll override required.
PayrollBot: HR-4782 created by Aisha. Assigned to Payroll Ops. ETA for manual entry: 3 business days. Reference: payroll-cutoff Jul-01.
Ethan Lee: Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.
Aisha (People Ops): Final note: this is a one-off exception and won't change general policy — we'll log it in the exception registry. Closing thread once payroll confirms entry. :white_check_mark:
